context: A surge of activity on launch day
purpose: Handle a traffic surge; teach つぶやき/適切/削除/名無し/アプリケーション/記述/上記/特許

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 公開直後から、つぶやきが殺到してる！
lines.en: Right after launch, murmurs are flooding in!
lines.style: frantic dev reporting the surge, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: サーバー、適切に対応できてる？
lines.en: Is the server handling it appropriately?
lines.style: focused lead checking stability, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 一部の不正投稿を削除した。
lines.en: I deleted some of the fraudulent posts.
lines.style: busy dev reporting his action, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 名無しの悪質ユーザーは、ブロックしよう。
lines.en: Let’s block the malicious anonymous users.
lines.style: decisive lead giving the order, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: アプリケーションの動作は安定してるよ。
lines.style: reassured dev confirming health, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ログに、エラーの内容を記述しておいて。
lines.en: Describe the errors in the logs.
lines.style: methodical lead delegating a task, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 上記の対応で、だいぶ落ち着いた。
lines.en: With the above measures, it calmed down a lot.
lines.style: relieved dev noting recovery, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: この急場の対応技術、特許級だよ。
lines.style: impressed lead praising the work, tone holding steady through the whole line
